CREATE TABLE contest (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        type TEXT NOT NULL,
        phase TEXT NOT NULL,
        start_time INTEGER,
        duration INTEGER NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE contest_remind (
        guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        contest_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (guild_id, contest_id, user_id)
    )

CREATE TABLE daily (
        guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        day INTEGER NOT NULL,
        problem_key TEXT,
        rating INTEGER,
        issued_at INTEGER,
        solved_at INTEGER,
        match_id INTEGER REFERENCES matches (id),
        PRIMARY KEY (guild_id, user_id, day)
    )

CREATE TABLE mashup_excluded (
        mashup_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES mashups (id),
        problem_key TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (mashup_id, problem_key)
    )

CREATE TABLE mashup_logged (
        mashup_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES mashups (id),
        problem_key TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (mashup_id, problem_key)
    )

CREATE TABLE mashup_players (
        mashup_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES mashups (id),
        guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        handle TEXT NOT NULL,
        joined_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
        active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, team INTEGER, delta INTEGER,
        PRIMARY KEY (mashup_id, user_id)
    )

CREATE TABLE mashup_problems (
        mashup_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES mashups (id),
        idx INTEGER NOT NULL,
        problem_key TEXT NOT NULL,
        rating INTEGER NOT NULL, cell INTEGER, since INTEGER,
        PRIMARY KEY (mashup_id, idx)
    )

CREATE TABLE mashup_solves (
        mashup_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES mashups (id),
        user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        problem_key TEXT NOT NULL,
        solved_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
        wrong INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        PRIMARY KEY (mashup_id, user_id, problem_key)
    )

CREATE TABLE mashups (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        message_id INTEGER,
        host_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        min_rating INTEGER NOT NULL,
        max_rating INTEGER NOT NULL,
        count INTEGER NOT NULL,
        duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,
        penalty_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('lobby', 'active', 'finished', 'cancelled')),
        created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
        started_at INTEGER,
        ends_at INTEGER
    , teams INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, max_players INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 20, rated INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, team_size INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, tags TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', exclude_tags TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', contest_id INTEGER, mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'contest', size INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, win TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'line', thread_id INTEGER, log_board_id INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE match_players (
        match_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES matches (id),
        guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        handle TEXT NOT NULL,
        joined_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
        solved_at INTEGER,
        gave_up INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        delta INTEGER,
        active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
        PRIMARY KEY (match_id, user_id)
    )

CREATE TABLE matches (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        message_id INTEGER,
        host_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('solo', 'duel', 'custom')),
        max_players INTEGER NOT NULL,
        invited_id INTEGER,
        rating_arg INTEGER,
        rating INTEGER,
        problem_key TEXT,
        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('lobby', 'active', 'finished', 'cancelled')),
        created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
        started_at INTEGER,
        expires_at INTEGER,
        finished_at INTEGER
    , tags TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', exclude_tags TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

CREATE TABLE newcontest (
        guild_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE newcontest_sent (
        guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        contest_id INTEGER NOT NULL, soon INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        PRIMARY KEY (guild_id, contest_id)
    )
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_active_mashup ON mashup_players (guild_id, user_id) WHERE active = 1
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_active_match ON match_players (guild_id, user_id) WHERE active = 1

CREATE TABLE pending_link (
        guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        handle TEXT NOT NULL,
        problem_key TEXT NOT NULL,
        issued_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (guild_id, user_id)
    )

CREATE TABLE problem (
        contest_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        idx TEXT NOT NULL,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        rating INTEGER,
        tags TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (contest_id, idx)
    )

CREATE TABLE recap (
        guild_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE recap_sent (
        guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        contest_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (guild_id, contest_id)
    )

CREATE TABLE "reminder" (
        guild_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        channel_id INTEGER,
        role_id INTEGER,
        before_mins TEXT NOT NULL,
        exclude TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
    )

CREATE TABLE reminder_sent (
        guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        contest_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        before_min INTEGER NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (guild_id, contest_id, before_min)
    )

CREATE TABLE user_handle (
        guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        handle TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE,
        rating INTEGER,
        PRIMARY KEY (guild_id, user_id),
        UNIQUE (guild_id, handle)
    )

CREATE TABLE weekly (
        guild_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        last_sent INTEGER NOT NULL
    )
